chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Zurarah, who said:
He would cleanse himself from urine three times, and from feces with clods and cloths.

key_terms.الْخِرَقِ: pieces of cloth used for cleaning
key_terms.الْمَدَرِ: clods of earth used for cleaning
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِي: he cleansed himself after relieving himself

ai.seo_question: How did he perform istinja' from urine and feces according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a practice of istinja' after relieving oneself. It indicates cleansing from urine three times and cleansing from feces by using clods and cloths, reflecting rulings related to taharah and ritual purity.
